name: ChinaWander
summary:
Explore China, one street at a time. View 360° panoramas in VR for relaxed discovery, revisiting familiar places and getting to know a destination before a trip.

• Discover a random location or choose a place on the map.
• Search for destinations and follow available road connections.
• Browse available historical imagery by date and source.
• Save favorite views in local folders and return to recent visits.
• Read nearby encyclopedia entries and listen to optional ambient recordings.
• Use Simplified Chin
